params.message:
Say what the note labels mean in the context form

"Is het ook" followed by two toggles named Risico and Gewoonte of
afspraak did not say what ticking them meant. The form now has two
checkboxes with a plain sentence each: "Dit kan mislopen als niemand
het weet" and "Dit is een vaste afspraak of gewoonte". The short names
stay on the notes, the filters on Bespreken and the export.
